# US dollars spent out of the bank, stating the cost basis of the loan rather
# than one of the bank's.
#
# 500.00 USD are bought at 1.30 into the bank, which opens a cost basis on the
# held side. 1,000.00 USD are borrowed at 1.30 into the same bank, stated in
# Canadian dollars, which opens a cost basis on each side: the dollars held and
# the dollars owed. The sale then takes 100.00 USD out of the bank and states
# the loan's cost basis, which stands for dollars owed, not dollars held. It is
# valued at the 1.30 both cost, so it realizes nothing and states no gain.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_every_split_that_spends_draws_on_a_cost_basis_of_its_own_side.py.
2033-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2033-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2033-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Liabilities:USD Loan
	type: "Liability"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2033-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2033-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2033-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -5000.00 CAD

2033-01-05 * "Buy 500.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "650.00"
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000011"
	Assets:CAD Bank -650.00 CAD

2033-01-06 * "Borrow 1,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1300.00"
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000012"
	Liabilities:USD Loan -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-1300.00"
		guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000013"

2033-02-01 * "Sell 100.00 USD out of the bank, stating the loan's cost basis"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-130.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0f0f0000000000000000000000000013"
	Assets:CAD Bank 130.00 CAD
